title: Pursa Khabool Kijiye Shahzadiye Kounain (Title)
body:
Pursa qubool kijiye shehzadiye kounain
Sab ka salam lijiye mazllom ya Hussain
Zainab ka wo gham khaar ka pura qubool ho
Massom aza daar ka pursa qubool ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Sajjad ka bimar ka pursa qubool ho
Afat mein giraftar ka pursa qubool ho
Abbas-e-alamdarka pursa qubool ho aur akber-e-jarrar ka pursa qubool ho
Wo pyaas key salar ka pursa qubool ho
<<DIVIDER>>
Sughra ka wo bimar ka pursa qubool ho
